text:
LB::context_id
Description
Assign the current connection to a named context.
Syntax
LB
::
context_id
"id_string"
LB::context_id <id_string>
Assigns the current connection to a named context. The connections in
the same context can be reused later.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
LB
::
context_id
foo
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
